_doc: Bridge between the 5-class project ontology (02_layout_pipeline/ontology.md) and ADE20K, the label space ControlNet-seg (lllyasviel/control_v11p_sd15_seg) was trained on.
condition: which ADE20K class colour each project class is painted with before it is fed to ControlNet. ControlNet only 'understands' ADE20K colours, so our own palette cannot be passed directly.

evaluation_groups: which ADE20K classes, when predicted by the evaluator segmenter on a generated image, count as each project class. Groups must be disjoint. Any ADE20K class not listed in a group counts as FOREIGN, i.e. an object category the layout cannot contain: a hallucination by definition.

condition_candidates: alternatives for the classes with no exact ADE20K equivalent (installation, pit). The choice is an empirical A/B decision made with the Hallucinated Object Rate itself; see README.
